mapper.sql: select t.trip_id, t.activity_id, t.guest_id, t.trip_type, t.transport_type, t.transport_no, t.trip_date, t.from_place, t.to_place, t.depart_time, t.arrive_time, t.price, t.ticket_status, t.pickup_status, t.del_flag, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_by, t.update_time, t.remark, g.guest_name, g.phone as guest_phone from yc_guest_trip t left join yc_guest g on g.guest_id=t.guest_id and g.del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select count(1) as totalCount, ifnull(sum(case when trip_type='come' then 1 else 0 end),0) as comeCount, ifnull(sum(case when trip_type='return' then 1 else 0 end),0) as returnCount, ifnull(sum(case when ticket_status='1' then 1 else 0 end),0) as issuedCount from yc_guest_trip where activity_id=#{activityId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.delete: update yc_guest_trip set del_flag='2' where trip_id in #{id}
